description: This file defines classes and structures related to signing messages in a security context, including error handling, message structures, and interfaces for signing and requesting signatures, primarily used in a secure environment or UI confirmation flow.

classes.name: ConfUiSignerImpl
classes.description: Implements the core signing logic, error status management, and communication over file descriptors.

classes.name: ConfUiSignSender
classes.description: Handles sending signature requests and receiving responses in a secure environment.

classes.name: ConfUiSignRequester
classes.description: Handles requesting signatures and receiving responses, typically used by a confirmation UI host.

methods.name: IsIoError
methods.description: Checks if the last error was an I/O error.

methods.name: IsLogicError
methods.description: Checks if the last error was a logic error.

methods.name: IsOk
methods.description: Checks if the last operation was successful without errors.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message with an error code and payload over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives a message and returns a SignRawMessage if successful.
